calendar.matters:
HEARING ON SHARIF DEY, A/K/A ROSCOE ENDRE LEE DUNCAN, A/K/A ROSCOE DUNCAN'S PETITION FOR CHANGE OF NAME

Off Calendar Jun-14-2024 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: The matter came on for Change of name of Petitioner Sharif Dey aka Roscoe Duncan.

Dept.505; Judge: Maria Evangelista; Clerk: N. Webb; Proceedings recorded by "For the Record" commencing at 9:25 am. and concluding at 9:46 am.

Petitioner Sharif Dey aka Roscoe Duncan appeared in pro per, was placed under oath and testified.

Petition for change of name and gender filed January 16, 2024.

Order to show cause filed January 16, 2024.

Notice of hearing filed May 20, 2024.

The Court addresses the petitioner.

The Petitioner provides testimony.

After reviewing the petition, hearing the testimony and there are no objections filed, The Court grants Petitioner's request for change of name.

Decree Recognizing Change of Name signed and filed this day.(D505)
